name: bao
description: Bao — local agent kitchen. A local-first AI agent workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/gateway && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
